_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: Choose topics, allowance and emphasis and receive a complete packet (charter, stance message, goal kernel) with size gates, launched into a Web Console Codex session automatically or shown as two messages to paste (G1).
requirements.title: One-action launch

validation.notes: packet.py gates (charter bytes, stance, kernel) on a prepared packet
automatic launch types the stance and kernel and records each step in LAUNCH.json
the two messages to paste are a read (GetLaunchMessages) and write nothing
a failed gate refuses before any session exists
one automatic launch into a throwaway Web Console session (docs/internal/evidence/launch-proof.txt)

requirements.description: Before launch, state per selected topic whether an earlier commission touches it, its observed state (live, paused, limited, stopped, ended, prepared, unknown), and what this launch does about it; refuse to double-supervise a live topic unless the operator explicitly runs alongside (G2).
requirements.title: Clean-start verdict

validation.notes: only an open commission blocks; supersede or run alongside resolves it in the request
prepared only with proof nothing started it
overlapping commissions per topic

requirements.description: A bad start is stopped (never deleted), verified inactive, marked discarded with the operator's reason, and relaunched as a new commission rebuilt from the same packet inputs, superseding the old one (G2).
requirements.title: Discard and relaunch

validation.notes: stop never deletes the session
relaunch is a new commission from the same inputs
discard and relaunch through packet.py

requirements.description: Show active research, last activity per topic, running supervisors, the topics each supervises and commissions overlapping in time, derived only from research-home files and harness session records, with unknown where a value cannot be derived (G3, I6).
requirements.title: Activity projection

validation.notes: every derived value has a source or is unknown
state from Codex session records
last activity per run folder
an unreadable file is unknown, never empty
`make real-home-check`: read-only invariants over the real research home (docs/internal/evidence/real-home-check.txt)

requirements.description: Operator direction is appended verbatim to a desk-owned operator file the supervisor already re-reads at unit start; nothing is sent into a supervisor conversation (G4, I4).
requirements.title: File-only steering

validation.notes: entries appended verbatim to OPERATOR.md
4,000-character entries
say and enable steering

requirements.description: Needs-you items written by supervisors become one feed, are delivered to Notification Hub as decisions, and answers are read back from the Hub into the operator file, so a desk or webhook outage loses no answer; the UI answers directly when the Hub is down (G5, I5).
requirements.title: Decision courier

validation.notes: ask raised and answer read back into OPERATOR.md
old items are never sent
nothing delivered while answers cannot be read
the desk answers directly

requirements.description: Measure and display each supervisor and owner role's read set, as listed in the research-coordination skill's limits.json, in bytes and estimated tokens, and flag sets over their ceilings, an oversized charter and appended amendments (G6, I7).
requirements.title: Focus measurement

validation.notes: read sets measured from limits.json with flags
no-growth: role totals within ceilings

requirements.description: A research-review skill and desk support for an operator review session over selected topics: evidence of accomplishment, tidy-up proposals, verdicts recorded verbatim and missions realigned only by explicit operator action (G7).
requirements.title: Review support

validation.notes: review topics, proposals and verbatim verdicts; MISSION.md untouched

requirements.description: Research skills move into scenarios/research-desk/skills through the supported ownership route with prompt-manager skill read and the direct-file fallback still working, and the supervisor procedure gains written route discipline for failing optional routes (G8, G9).
requirements.title: Scenario-owned research skills

validation.notes: skill-set: prompt-manager skill-set validate research-desk passes; each moved id listed exactly once; old pack path resolves through the link (docs/guides/skills-move.md §1) (proof: docs/concepts/SYSTEM.md §12)
unit: rendered charter contains the route-discipline procedure and the Decisions override line (proof: docs/concepts/SYSTEM.md §12)

requirements.description: Stopping the desk mid-commission changes nothing for supervisors or owners; every packet launches by hand from its folder; commissions launched by hand are recognised (I1, I3).
requirements.title: Detached by construction

validation.notes: only the live instance writes
a desk stop mid-launch is recorded, nothing else changes
hand-launched and desk-launched commissions are recognised

requirements.description: API and CLI first, then a UI designed for phone width on the tunnel hostname that replaces the generated placeholder completely (G10).
requirements.title: Phone-first interface

validation.notes: ui: 390 px screenshots on the tunnel hostname of Now, Commission, Launch, Review; detemplate leaves no notes example (proof: docs/concepts/SYSTEM.md §12)
a11y: 44 px targets; state as words, never colour alone (proof: docs/concepts/SYSTEM.md §12)

requirements.title: Control without chat
requirements.description: Pause, resume, wind down, stop and discard a commission from the desk without writing a message in its conversation; wind down is an operator-file entry, the others act on the session only on an operator tap and are recorded (G12).

validation.notes: pause, resume and stop act only on an open window and are recorded
controls reach only the commission's own thread
wind down is an operator-file entry

requirements.title: Since last look
requirements.description: Per commission and per topic, show what changed since the operator last looked: new ledger text, changed checkpoints, showcase lines and workstream status changes (G13).

validation.notes: changes since the recorded look or --since
ledger text, checkpoints, showcase lines and statuses
